top_signals.title: Supply driven trucking market cycle explained in the data
top_signals.summary:
Tender volumes have gone nowhere for two years. Rejections have tripled. The data says this cycle has been defined by capacity leaving the market — not by surging freight demand.

top_signals.title: NASA’s Roman Telescope Takes Aim at Cosmic Mysteries
top_signals.summary: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy on a mission to study dark energy, dark matter and planets beyond our solar system. Roman is headed about 1 million miles from Earth to Lagrange point 2, where its wide field of view will allow scientists to survey billions of galaxies far faster than the Hubble telescope. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend to watch the launch with hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz is Space Network Co-Founder and COO Ross Hamilton to discuss the telescope's mission. (Source: Bloomberg)
